title: Sales -> Product: Rapid aggregation workflow for enterprise feature asks
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Create a lightweight, repeatable workflow that turns inbound enterprise feature requests from Sales/Customer Success into an aggregated, prioritized queue with an initial scoping artifact that Product can act on. The goal is to reduce lead time from request to first-product-evaluation to under 5 business days for high-value accounts, ensure consistent economic signals are captured, and provide a clear lane recommendation (Immediate / Strategic / Backlog). This ticket defines the flow, scoring heuristics, required metadata, and the first-pass artifact template for PM review.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible intake workflow documented in Confluence that Sales/CS can follow to submit batch requests
Automated aggregator (simple script or Zapier flow) groups requests by account and feature theme and outputs a CSV or dashboard snapshot
Priority score computed for each grouped request reflecting ARR proxy, contract stage, account tier, and compliance/regulatory flags
First-pass scoping artifact (one-pager) generated for each request group including: user story, estimated dev effort (T-shirt), key dependencies, compliance notes, and recommended lane
PMs receive an aggregated weekly digest and an on-demand queue view with filters for ARR, strategic_flag, and region
Playbook includes escalation rules for cross-functional blockers and a clear handoff to Eng/Design if a request is accepted for discovery
steps: Define minimal request schema Sales/CS must provide (account, contact, ARR estimate, use case, priority, regulatory constraints, relevant contracts/PRs)
Implement lightweight intake form (Typeform/Sheets/GForm) and one-click Sales templates for common asks
Build aggregator: scheduled job that clusters similar asks by NLP on feature description + account tags
Apply scoring heuristic: ARR proxy (0-10), Contract Stage multiplier, Strategic Bet flag (+3), Compliance cost (penalty), Effort estimate divisor
Produce one-pager template populated with aggregated signals for PM triage
Publish weekly digest to PM Slack channel and update the enterprise-intake dashboard
decisions: Keep initial aggregator lightweight (no ML model training) — use cosine similarity on embeddings for clustering to accelerate rollout
Score must surface economics first (ARR proxy) but preserve a manual override for strategic bets from Sales leadership
Store minimal sensitive data in intake artifacts; link to secure attachments in Drive for contracts instead of copying content
Initial rollout limited to NA and EU Sales regions to validate heuristics before APAC expansion
